question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: We support UPI, debit cards, credit cards, net banking, wallet payments, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible orders.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for eligible orders in select areas. You'll see the COD option at checkout if it's available for your location.

question: Can I pay with UPI?
answer: Yes! We support all major UPI apps including Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, and more. Simply choose UPI at checkout.

question: Why was my payment deducted but order not placed?
answer: If payment was deducted but the order wasn't placed, the amount will be automatically refunded within 5–7 business days to your original payment method.

question: How do I apply a promo code?
answer: At checkout, tap 'Apply Coupon' or 'Have a promo code?' and enter your code. The discount will be applied instantly if the code is valid.

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Refunds typically take 5–7 business days for cards and net banking, 2–3 days for UPI, and immediate for wallet credits.

question: How do I request a refund?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the order, and tap 'Report an Issue'. Choose the appropriate reason and submit — our team will process your refund within 24 hours.

question: Will I get a refund if my order is cancelled?
answer: Yes, you'll receive a full refund for cancelled orders, provided cancellation was done before the restaurant started preparing your food.

question: Where can I check refund status?
answer: You can check refund status in 'My Orders' > select the order > 'Refund Status'. You'll also receive email/SMS notifications.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the active order, and tap 'Cancel Order'. Cancellation is free if the restaurant hasn't started preparing your food.

question: Can I cancel after the restaurant starts preparing?
answer: Once the restaurant starts preparing, cancellations may not be possible or may incur a partial charge. Contact support for assistance.

question: What if my order is automatically cancelled?
answer: If your order was auto-cancelled due to a restaurant or rider unavailability, you'll receive a full refund within 5–7 business days.

question: Is there a cancellation fee?
answer: No cancellation fee if cancelled before the restaurant begins preparation. A fee may apply if cancelled mid-preparation.

question: How are delivery charges calculated?
answer: Delivery charges depend on your distance from the restaurant, time of day, and current demand. The exact fee is shown before you place the order.

question: Why is the delivery fee high today?
answer: Delivery fees may be higher during peak hours, bad weather, or when demand exceeds driver availability. This is surge pricing and is temporary.

question: How can I get free delivery?
answer: Subscribe to our premium plan or use applicable promo codes to get free delivery. Some restaurants also offer free delivery above a minimum order value.

question: What is the minimum order for free delivery?
answer: The minimum order for free delivery varies by restaurant and typically ranges from ₹149 to ₹299. You'll see the threshold on the restaurant's page.

question: My order is late. What should I do?
answer: We're sorry for the delay! You can track your order live in the app. If it's unusually late, contact support for an update or compensation.

question: Will I get compensation for a late delivery?
answer: We may offer coupons or wallet credits for significantly delayed orders. Please contact support if your order is more than 30 minutes past the ETA.

question: Why is my order taking so long?
answer: Delays can occur due to high restaurant volume, traffic, bad weather, or peak hours. Check live tracking for an updated ETA.

question: Can I track my order in real-time?
answer: Yes! Once your order is picked up by the rider, you can track their live location on the map in the app.

question: The map is not updating. What should I do?
answer: Try refreshing the app or restarting it. If tracking is still not working, the rider may have connectivity issues — contact support.

question: How do I contact my delivery rider?
answer: You can call or message your rider directly from the live tracking screen. Tap the phone icon next to the rider's name.

question: My rider is not responding. What do I do?
answer: If your rider is unreachable, contact our customer support. We'll reassign or escalate your order immediately.

question: I received my order but an item is missing.
answer: We apologize! Go to 'My Orders', select the order, tap 'Report an Issue', and select 'Missing Items'. You'll receive a refund or replacement.

question: Can I get a refund for a missing item?
answer: Yes, refunds for missing items are typically processed within 24 hours after verification. You can also opt for store credit.

question: I received the wrong item.
answer: Please report this via 'My Orders' > 'Report an Issue' > 'Wrong Item'. We'll prioritize a refund or re-delivery for you.

question: Restaurant sent the wrong dish. Who is responsible?
answer: We hold our restaurant partners accountable for food quality and accuracy. Contact support and we'll ensure you're compensated.

question: My food arrived damaged or spilled.
answer: We're sorry! Please take a photo and report via 'My Orders' > 'Report an Issue'. We'll process a refund or replacement promptly.

question: The food packaging was open. Is it safe to eat?
answer: If the packaging appears tampered with, do not consume the food. Report via support — your safety is our priority and a full refund will be issued.

question: How do I place an order?
answer: Browse restaurants, add items to your cart, choose a delivery address, select payment, and tap 'Place Order'. It's that simple!

question: Can I add special instructions for my order?
answer: Yes! You can add special instructions for each item or the entire order at checkout. The restaurant will try their best to accommodate.

question: What is the minimum order amount?
answer: Minimum order amount varies by restaurant, usually between ₹99–₹199. You'll see this on the restaurant's page.

question: Can I modify my order after placing it?
answer: Orders can only be modified before the restaurant confirms them. Once confirmed, you'd need to cancel and re-order.

question: Can I change the delivery address after placing an order?
answer: Address changes are not guaranteed after order placement, but you can try calling the rider or contact support for assistance.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Download the app, tap 'Sign Up', enter your mobile number, verify via OTP, and set up your profile. It's free!

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: Tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, enter your registered email or phone, and follow the reset instructions sent to you.

question: How do I update my profile information?
answer: Go to Profile > Edit Profile to update your name, email, phone number, or profile picture. Some fields may require OTP verification.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Profile > Settings > Delete Account. Note that this is permanent and all data including order history will be lost.

question: I'm not receiving the OTP. What should I do?
answer: Wait 30 seconds before retrying. Make sure your number is correct and has SMS enabled. If the issue persists, try a call OTP.

question: How do I add a new delivery address?
answer: Go to Profile > Addresses > Add New Address. You can also add addresses during checkout by tapping on the address field.

question: How do I edit a saved address?
answer: Go to Profile > Addresses, select the address you want to edit, and tap the edit (pencil) icon.

question: Why is my coupon not working?
answer: Coupons may fail due to expiry, minimum order requirements, or applicability conditions. Check the coupon terms before using.

question: Where can I find active promo codes?
answer: Find promo codes in the 'Offers' section of the app, via email/SMS newsletters, or on our official social media pages.

question: Can I use multiple coupons on one order?
answer: No, only one coupon or promo code can be applied per order. Choose the one that offers the better discount.

question: What is the premium subscription?
answer: Our premium subscription offers unlimited free delivery, exclusive member-only discounts, early access to offers, and priority support.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Profile > Manage Subscription > Cancel Plan. Your benefits will continue until the end of the current billing cycle.

question: Is the premium subscription auto-renewed?
answer: Yes, subscriptions auto-renew monthly or annually. You'll receive a reminder 3 days before renewal. You can turn off auto-renewal anytime.

question: What is the FoodFlow wallet?
answer: The FoodFlow Wallet is a built-in digital wallet where you can store money and credits for quick, seamless payments.

question: How do I add money to my wallet?
answer: Go to Profile > Wallet > Add Money. You can add funds via UPI, cards, or net banking. The amount reflects instantly.

question: How do I use my wallet balance for payment?
answer: At checkout, select 'Wallet' as your payment method. The amount will be deducted from your wallet balance automatically.

question: Can I transfer wallet balance to a bank account?
answer: Wallet balances cannot currently be transferred to bank accounts. They can only be used within the FoodFlow platform.

question: How do I get a GST invoice?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the order, and tap 'Download Invoice'. You can add your GSTIN in Profile > Business Details for a GST invoice.

question: Can I get an invoice for a past order?
answer: Yes! Past order invoices can be downloaded from 'My Orders' > select the order > 'Download Invoice' at any time.

question: The restaurant rejected my order. What now?
answer: If a restaurant rejects your order, you'll receive a full refund automatically. Try ordering from a different restaurant.

question: The restaurant is not accepting orders.
answer: The restaurant may be temporarily closed or busy. Try again later or choose a different restaurant nearby.

question: The food quality was very poor. Who do I complain to?
answer: We take food quality seriously. Report via 'My Orders' > 'Report an Issue' > 'Poor Food Quality'. You may receive compensation.

question: How do I report a food safety concern?
answer: Your safety matters. Report any food safety or hygiene concerns via 'My Orders' > 'Report an Issue' > 'Food Safety'. Our team will investigate immediately.

question: Is contactless delivery available?
answer: Yes, select 'No-Contact Delivery' at checkout. The rider will leave the order at your doorstep and notify you.

question: How does no-contact delivery work?
answer: Choose no-contact delivery at checkout. The rider places your order at the door, takes a photo, and marks it delivered. You're notified via the app.

question: Can I schedule an order for later?
answer: Yes! At checkout, tap 'Schedule Delivery' and pick your preferred date and time. Orders can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance.

question: Can I cancel a scheduled order?
answer: Yes, you can cancel a scheduled order anytime before it moves into active preparation. Go to 'My Orders' > 'Cancel Order'.

question: Can I make a group order?
answer: Yes! Use the 'Group Order' feature to invite friends to add items to a shared cart. One person pays at checkout.

question: How do I share a group order link?
answer: Start a group order from any restaurant page and click 'Share Link'. Friends can use the link to add items from the same restaurant.

question: How do I earn loyalty points?
answer: You earn loyalty points on every successful order. Points are credited within 24 hours of delivery and can be redeemed on future orders.

question: How do I redeem my loyalty points?
answer: At checkout, you'll see the option to 'Use Points'. Enable it to apply your points toward the order total.

question: Do my loyalty points expire?
answer: Yes, loyalty points expire after 12 months of inactivity. Keep ordering to keep your points active!

question: What is surge pricing?
answer: Surge pricing temporarily increases delivery fees during high-demand periods like peak meal times or bad weather. It normalizes once demand drops.

question: How can I avoid surge pricing?
answer: Order during off-peak hours (late morning or early afternoon), schedule orders in advance, or wait a few minutes for surge to subside.

question: Why is the app not available in my city?
answer: We're expanding rapidly! If your city isn't listed, it may not be in our coverage area yet. Stay tuned for announcements about new cities.

question: What is the delivery coverage area?
answer: We deliver within a certain radius from our partner restaurants. The delivery area is shown on the restaurant's listing page.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach support via 'Help' in the app, our 24/7 chat support, or call our helpline. We typically respond within minutes.

question: What are the customer support hours?
answer: Our chat support is available 24/7. Phone support is available from 8 AM to 11 PM IST. Critical issues get priority round-the-clock.

question: The app keeps crashing. What should I do?
answer: Clear the app cache, update to the latest version, or reinstall the app. If the problem persists, contact support with your device details.

question: I can't log in to the app.
answer: Ensure your credentials are correct. Try resetting password, clear app cache, or reinstall. Contact support if the issue persists.

question: My app is showing an error.
answer: Try force-closing and reopening the app. Ensure you have a stable internet connection. Update the app if an update is available.

question: Notifications are not working.
answer: Ensure notifications are enabled for FoodFlow in your phone's settings. Also check that Do Not Disturb mode is off and battery optimization doesn't restrict the app.

question: How do I search for a restaurant?
answer: Use the search bar at the top of the home screen to find restaurants by name, cuisine, or dish.

question: How do I filter restaurants by cuisine?
answer: Use the category filters on the home screen (e.g., 'Indian', 'Chinese', 'Fast Food') to browse by cuisine type.

question: How do I reorder a past order?
answer: Go to 'My Orders', select the past order, and tap 'Reorder'. The same items will be added to your cart from the same restaurant.

question: How do I rate my order?
answer: After delivery, you'll receive a rating prompt. Tap the stars to rate the food and delivery, and optionally write a review.

question: Can I edit a review after submitting?
answer: Currently, submitted reviews cannot be edited. Please reach out to support if you'd like to update incorrect information.

question: Who sees my review?
answer: Your review is visible to other users on the restaurant page. Your personal details like phone or address are never shared.

question: What are the delivery stages?
answer: Order stages are: Order Placed → Restaurant Confirmed → Preparing → Picked Up → On the Way → Delivered.

question: Can I leave feedback for the restaurant?
answer: Yes, after delivery you can rate and review the restaurant. Your feedback helps improve quality for all users.

question: My first order discount didn't apply.
answer: First-order discounts apply only to verified new accounts. Ensure you're logged into a new account and the minimum order value is met.

question: Can I use the same account on multiple devices?
answer: Yes, you can log in from multiple devices. However, for security, active sessions on other devices may be prompted to re-verify.

question: Can I split the payment with a friend?
answer: Currently, split payment is not directly supported. One person can pay and others can reimburse manually, e.g., via UPI.

question: Is the delivery charge refundable?
answer: Delivery charges are generally non-refundable unless the order was cancelled before processing or due to a restaurant-side error.

question: Can I order from multiple restaurants at once?
answer: Currently, orders can only be placed from one restaurant at a time. Start a new order for a second restaurant.

question: What happens if an item I ordered is out of stock?
answer: The restaurant may contact you via the app or substitute the item. If no substitution is possible, that item will be refunded.

question: Will I be notified before my scheduled order starts?
answer: Yes, you'll receive an in-app notification and SMS 30 minutes before your scheduled order begins processing.

question: Can I speak to a human agent?
answer: Yes! Type 'Talk to an Agent' or tap 'Connect to Agent' in the support chat to be connected to a human support representative.

question: What happens to my refund if I have a pending wallet balance?
answer: Refunds can be credited to your FoodFlow Wallet for instant access, or to the original payment method for standard processing times.

question: Are restaurant hygiene ratings available?
answer: We partner only with FSSAI-certified restaurants. Hygiene ratings, where available, are shown on the restaurant's listing page.

question: Which areas do you deliver in?
answer: We currently deliver across 500+ cities in India. Enter your pincode or address on the app to check serviceable restaurants near you.

question: Will I get cashback on my order?
answer: Cashback offers are available periodically via specific payment methods or partner offers. Check the 'Offers' section for active cashback deals.

question: Can I get a coupon for my bad experience?
answer: We apologize for any bad experience. Contact our support team and we'll evaluate and may issue a goodwill coupon or credit.

question: Payment failed but money was deducted.
answer: If payment failed but money was deducted, it will be auto-refunded within 3–7 business days. Contact your bank if it exceeds this time.

question: The restaurant is always showing as busy.
answer: Restaurants may show as 'Busy' during peak hours or if they're managing many orders. Try ordering at off-peak times or choose another restaurant.

question: Can I see the rider's name and photo?
answer: Yes! Once your order is picked up, you can see the rider's name, photo, and rating on the live tracking screen.

question: Do premium members get free delivery?
answer: Yes, premium/subscription members enjoy unlimited free delivery on eligible orders, regardless of the order value.

question: Can I change my payment method after placing an order?
answer: Payment method cannot be changed once the order is placed. Cancel and re-order if you want to use a different payment option.

question: I received fewer quantities than ordered.
answer: We're sorry for short quantities! Report via 'My Orders' > 'Report an Issue' > 'Missing Items'. We'll process a partial refund.

question: How do I change my registered phone number?
answer: Go to Profile > Edit Profile > Phone Number. You'll need to verify your old number via OTP before entering the new one.

question: Is there a dark mode in the app?
answer: Yes! Go to Profile > Settings > Display > Dark Mode to enable it. The app supports both light and dark themes.

question: How do I add items to my favourites?
answer: Tap the heart icon on any restaurant or food item to add it to your favourites list for quick access later.

question: Can I order in advance for tomorrow morning?
answer: Yes! Use the 'Schedule Delivery' feature to book your order up to 7 days in advance, including for tomorrow morning.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Absolutely. We use 256-bit SSL encryption for all transactions. We are PCI-DSS compliant and never store your full card details.

question: Why was my order partially fulfilled?
answer: Some items may be unavailable at the restaurant. You'll be notified and refunded for any unfulfilled items automatically.

question: Can I cancel an already delivered order?
answer: Orders cannot be cancelled once delivered. However, if there's an issue (wrong item, missing item), you can file a complaint for a refund.

question: How many points do I earn per order?
answer: You earn 1 loyalty point for every ₹10 spent. Points can be redeemed as discounts on future orders.

question: Does FoodFlow have temperature-controlled delivery?
answer: Riders use insulated delivery bags to maintain food temperature. However, temperature consistency depends on transit time.

question: How do I sign out of the app?
answer: Go to Profile > Settings > Sign Out. You'll be logged out and need to sign in again next time.

question: How do I download the FoodFlow app?
answer: FoodFlow is available on the Google Play Store (Android) and Apple App Store (iOS). Search 'FoodFlow' and tap Install.
